name: Azuma Morio
source:
An ambitious architect who lives in Shionagi. Contrary to his delicate style of doing work he is a bit of an airhead.
For [url=https://vndb.org/c21481]Ryousuke[/url] he's someone he admires and looks up to.
His work on the aquarium "Marinpia Shionagi" known as his initial masterpiece.
